entries.hypothesis: Combine mean-reversion signals from alpha factors that capture deviations from VWAP and close price (e.g., alpha_005, alpha_041, alpha_057) with momentum factors that signal continuations during high-volume days (e.g., alpha_007, alpha_019). This strategy aims to identify stocks that are temporarily mispriced relative to their intrinsic value while also capitalizing on short-term momentum fueled by increased trading activity.
entries.selection_rationale:
alpha_005: This factor captures mean-reversion around the VWAP, allowing us to identify stocks that are mispriced relative to volume-weighted fair value.
alpha_041: By measuring the deviation between the geometric midprice and VWAP, it further enhances the mean-reversion signals, complementing the VWAP-focused strategy.
alpha_007: This momentum factor signals price continuation during high-volume days, aligning well with the hypothesis of leveraging market conviction.
alpha_019: As a contrarian momentum factor, it allows us to fade short-term moves while considering long-term trends, enhancing the strategy's robustness.
alpha_057: Captures deviations of the close from VWAP, reinforcing the mean-reversion approach by focusing on recent price behaviors.
jump_volume_reversal: This factor identifies potential reversals during significant price jumps, capturing market reactions that align with the high-volume momentum aspect of the strategy.
intraday_volume_variation_signal: Captures real-time volume changes, providing insights into immediate market interest, which can help validate both mean-reversion and momentum signals.
fat_tail_volume_variation: This factor highlights stocks with significant volume spikes, indicating heightened market activity, which can leverage the momentum aspect of the strategy.

stat_tests.summary: OOS Sharpe 0.99 vs IS 1.55 (decay 36%). Edge persists.

entries.name: Mean-Reversion Momentum
